integrity: The all-length statement is supported by a combinatorial proof. Self-contained finite checks reproduce the complete rotation BWT through sum-of-gaps 35 and the indexed-word counts through length 23; finite tests do not replace infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Circular multiset-of-rotations BWT only, fixed binary weight three, integer lengths at least four, alphabet order 0<1; potential unindexed equivalent literature is not excluded. The classical two-run characterization is prior work and not claimed as new.
title: Exact run spectrum of the circular Burrows–Wheeler transform for binary words with three ones
